title: Core Nonet #03
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, nine women in a single row.

A photograph of NINE women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 9 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left to right:
[Pakistani Bridal Glam / Super Glamour]: Pakistani woman, mid 40s, demure and soft, gold-dust eyeshadow, a deep maroon lip, richly detailed bridal makeup, warm brown skin, elegant updo hair, oval nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: leaning one arm on a window frame. Shoes: extreme mother-of-pearl platform stiletto corset-lace boots.

[Balkan glam / Polynesian Goddess]: Romanian woman, late 20s, demure and soft, warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, long dark-brown hair in glossy voluminous waves, an intense, proud expression, elegant updo hair, stiletto nails (glittery). Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 9, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
